title: The Nashville House
description:
Welcome to The Nashville House, a hidden gem in Nashville, Tennessee designed for creatives. Our cozy and intimate retreat offers an unparalleled experience for musicians seeking inspiration and a peaceful space to create.

This beautifully, newly renovated, clean, well stocked house requires a 4 day minimum booking, removing it from being selected for bridal party tourism and partying in general.

The space
Ideal for guests working on music projects in Music City, that want a clean, safe, quiet place to wind down after working all day, to recharge their creativity. 

🛏️The house will comfortably hold (4) guests. There are (2) bedrooms and a pull-out couch. Parking is free and can hold up to (2) cars. 

🛑Unfortunately, we do not accept any 1st Bookings from new Air B&B Guests with no Prior feedback.

🔥Enjoy high speed wifi, Apple TV, Full Kitchen, Espresso Machine, Modern Appliances, Ice Maker, Garbage Disposal, Oven/Stove, and Double Sink 

🛁 Luxury 1 & 1/2 Baths with Jacuzzi Tub, and full 2 person Walk in Granite / Stone Shower.

 🚘We are conveniently located one minute away from Berry-Hill City Hall, 100 Oakes and Thompson Lane at E.Iris. We are seven minutes from Green Hills, Music Row, Airport, and Downtown Nashville (traffic permitting) 🎵100 Year old, Charming Kimball Baby Grand Piano, and assorted musical instruments PERMIT #2024099624
